body_binding.acceptance: Body candidate. Extreme poses/camera/skirt contact review pending.
body_binding.arm_partition: Surface-distance seeds with 100-step adjacency smoothing; hands fixed to arm family, torso centers fixed, UV seam copies share adjacency.

Blink.driver: Resident blink clock; sleep forces 1.0 and waking restores the ordinary clock.

TiredEyes.driver: clamp((fatigue - 0.55) / 0.45, 0.0, 0.7); narrows the painted eyes and shades the under-eye region.

face_controls.implementation: Godot UV eye shader on the unchanged source atlas; not GLB facial morph targets.
limits: Only two UV shader controls are implemented. There is no separated Face mesh or six-control blend-shape face.
Head gaze uses the existing DEF-head rig/contact system; it is not an iris LookLeft/LookRight control.
Hair-aging masks for the generated atlas are not implemented; old 8x8 palette-cell remapping remains disabled.
Saki has no production Smile/mouth morph. The two controls are shader effects on the unchanged painted atlas.
One physical eye crosses a UV seam; a third calibrated UV chart covers the same eye using the occlusion method.
face_controls.lod_policy: The actor retains one owned shader material, source atlas and eye-uniform values when swapping LOD meshes.

locomotion_measurement.limitation: Playback best fit only; variable inherited stance velocity does not prove zero sliding.
locomotion_measurement.method: Mean backward foot-joint velocity in target low-support window (within40mm of each foot minimum).

manifest.production_status: Body geometry/skin candidate frozen after numerical UV/pixel/rig/clip checks, pose review and clean reimport. Actual Godot material, eyes, LOD transitions and furniture/feet contacts remain separate acceptance steps.
